concepts.name: Operational Workbench
concepts.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity production-quality Spanish desktop web application UI concept for an independent INTERNAL ACADEMIC PLANNING SYSTEM used by university school staff. Use-case: ui-mockup. Target viewport 1440 × 900, landscape, crisp legible UI, full application frame edge-to-edge without browser chrome or device mockup. Current date anchor 7 November 2026. Planning target explicitly 2027-I; any weekly timetable is a recurring "Semana tipo", not a dated calendar. Design exploration only, all data synthetic; include a compact persistent "Demo · datos sintéticos" label. No university crest, no real staff names.

Grounding: repository React/TypeScript/TanStack Router/Vite. Existing features: select courses and demand/capacity, configure teacher/room availability and qualification, bounded deterministic schedule generation with possible incomplete result, valid manual time/resource adjustments, persisted proposals, simulated teacher conformity/observations, approval and immutable publication versions. Current UI uses one long page and student SUM styling. Attached existing screenshots are FUNCTIONAL REFERENCES ONLY: do not copy their visual design, blue SUM shell, Poppins, repeated cards or personal-looking names. Student screens are a separate product and must not be depicted or redesigned. Do not imply working authentication, AI chat, automatic demand adjustment, optimal-solution proof, institutional integration, or other unimplemented features.

Shared synthetic scenario: school Sistemas, period 2027-I, six synthetic courses, 12 sections, 24 required components. SYN-C501 Bases de datos: demand90/cap30/3sections; SYN-C502 Ingeniería de requisitos:60/30/2; SYN-C503 Redes I:60/30/2; SYN-C504 Arquitectura de software:60/30/2; SYN-C505 Sistemas operativos:45/30/2; SYN-C506 Planeamiento de recursos:30/30/1. Resource names Docente SYN-01 through SYN-04, Aula SYN-A101 and SYN-A102, Lab SYN-L201. Use readable short names and codes, never lengthy paragraphs in schedule blocks. Saved draft revision r7 is distinct from publication v1. Numbers must be internally coherent.

Composition rules: focused primary task, one clearly dominant next action, only essential supporting actions. Use typography, alignment, spacing and thin separators before panels, borders or shadows. Body14-16px, table14px, modest title24px. Professional information density, no card grids, no KPI decoration, no gradients/glow, no excessive badges, no decorative illustration. Color always paired with text/symbol. Strong text contrast. Show realistic state, but do not squeeze every workflow or state into one screen. All controls fit naturally, no cropped columns or illegible typography.

DIRECTION NAME: Mesa de programación — Operational Workbench.
Design a genuinely TABLE-FIRST operational workspace, serious restrained technical editorial style. IBM Plex Sans-like typography, tabular numerals, small monospace resource IDs; charcoal/slate rail, white working surface, deep forest green primary action, amber only for pending status. No purple, no student portal.
Layout: 180px quiet dark left navigation with the product name "Programación" and only four destinations "Propuestas" active, "Demanda", "Recursos", "Publicaciones"; bottom small role "Escuela · simulada". Full-width compact top scope bar "Sistemas [v] / 2027-I [v]" and "Demo · datos sintéticos". Main title "Programación regular" with "Borrador r7 · Guardado", small "Guardar" secondary action. Beneath, simple workflow text steps "Preparación — Horario — Revisión docente — Aprobación", Horario active, not big stepper circles.
Show RESULT AFTER A SEARCH LIMIT, a safe partial schedule: concise inline status bar "Búsqueda inconclusa · 22 de 24 componentes asignados", supporting "11 de 12 secciones completas", "0 cruces en lo asignado". Do not say unsatisfiable or complete. Dominant action "Revisar pendientes"; secondary text "Volver a generar"; no enabled Publish button.
Main work region split 70/30: left wide dense semantic-looking table of sections, grouped by course with headers "Asignatura", "Sección", "Demanda", "Tope", "Docente", "Ambiente", "Horario". Show about 9 clean rows, selected "Redes I / 02" row with amber left mark and "Pendiente" in assignment columns, sensible other rows with synthetic resources and hour ranges. Rows about42px, left-align names, right-align counts, light dividers, editable cell indicators sparingly. Use course grouping to avoid repeating all names. Toolbar "Secciones 12" with concise segmented control "Tabla | Semana" and search. No decorative metrics.
Right contextual inspector separated by one vertical rule titled "Redes I · Sección 02", "2 componentes pendientes". State explicitly "La búsqueda alcanzó su límite. No prueba que no exista solución." Present short actual reviewable constraints "Laboratorio requerido", "Capacidad mínima 30", "Docente SYN-03 · Lun–Vie 08:00–18:00", plus small availability strip or compact mini weekly matrix and "Editar recursos" secondary action. No invented cause certainty.
Bottom of working surface one collapsed line "Detalles de búsqueda" and clear disabled text action "Enviar a revisión" with reason "Completa las 12 secciones".
Make this visually exceptional through exact alignment, thoughtful whitespace and dense calm hierarchy. Distinct practical administrative workbench.

DIRECTION NAME: Taller de horarios — Visual Planning Studio.
Design a genuinely CALENDAR-FIRST planning tool with NO persistent dark sidebar. Its visual composition must be completely different from a table-led administrative workbench. Use a thin full-width white top command bar with typographic "Programación", scope selectors "Sistemas [v]" and "2027-I [v]", "Demo · datos sintéticos" aligned right. Light cool mineral gray base, crisp white calendar, muted petrol blue and teal accent system, near-black type, restrained orange for an incomplete item. Inter-like sans, tabular numerals. No large headline; header "Horario regular" at24px, "Borrador r7 · Cambios sin guardar". A slim second line navigation "Demanda / Recursos / Horario / Revisión / Versiones", Horario active with underline. Save secondary.
State: partial proposal after bounded search, 22/24 components assigned and 11/12 sections complete; unassigned Redes I S02 awaiting placement. Show a proposed placement PREVIEW of that section, not saved or yet validated. This is a proposed interaction concept: drag is an optional future enhancement; explicit day/time form editing must be visible and primary reliable path. Do not show a fabricated successful save, live optimization, or AI assistant.
Below toolbar "Semana tipo · 2027-I", "Por sección [v]" and cycle filter, calendar/list segmented control. Main canvas about900px wide plus left unassigned tray200px and right contextual inspector260px. Dominant five-column Monday–Friday recurring weekly timetable with hour axis08:00–18:00, 60min rows and clearly aligned block durations; no real calendar dates or today's line. At most8 compact course blocks, short course name, S01/S02 and resource ID each. Teal-tinted blocks all valid, visible text labels not color-only. A tiny lock only where meaningful "Conforme" frozen assignments. Horizontal cross-course same-time blocks allowed when resources differ.
Left tray header "Por ubicar", one amber-bordered item "Redes I · S02", "2 componentes · 4 h", "Lab · 30 plazas". Below a quiet contextual resource switch "Docentes | Ambientes", selected Docente SYN-03, 8h/20h weekly load shown as simple text not a KPI widget. Avoid showing all features.
Calendar has one outlined dashed rectangular ghost spanning Friday14:00–18:00 labeled "Redes I · S02", "Vista previa", muted amber outline. It MUST NOT overlap another event in same resource lane; do not signal conflict until server validation. Inspector header "Redes I · Sección02", sublabel "Ajuste sin validar"; fields "Docente SYN-03", "Lab SYN-L201", "Viernes", "14:00", "18:00" end time read-only because original4h duration preserved. Show components "Teoría 2h + Laboratorio 2h", and restrained note "El servidor validará el horario completo". Main primary action bottom inspector "Validar ajuste" deep petrol fill; "Descartar" as text. No publish or approval button in this task.
A low-height unobtrusive bottom status strip "22/24 componentes asignados · Búsqueda inconclusa" and link "Ver pendientes". Emphasize spatial clarity, real usable calendar, minimal UI chrome. Do not include overlapping illegible timetable cards. Use carefully measured spacing; professional design tool for scheduling, not a generic calendar app. Target entire composition1440×900 with ample calendar width; readable type.

Reclaim vertical space for calendar. Remove the decorative current date at right. Keep "Borrador r7 · Cambios sin guardar" and compact "Demo · datos sintéticos".

4. Calendar toolbar secondary text "Vista filtrada · 6 de 11 secciones asignadas". Global footer remains "22/24 componentes asignados · Búsqueda inconclusa" because whole proposal includes11 assigned sections and one pending.

Professional14px typography, thin grid, no heavy shadows, no gradients, no additional cards. Strong legibility. No new features or AI. No student SUM styling. This correction must read as a serious practical academic scheduling tool.

DIRECTION NAME: Expediente académico — Modern Institutional Platform.
Create a refined REVIEW-FIRST decision workspace, materially different from both dark-rail table workbench and full-width calendar studio. Strong editorial hierarchy and task progression, warm white paper-like flat background WITHOUT paper texture, charcoal ink, restrained wine/burgundy accent #742D3B, warm gray dividers. Source Sans3-like humanist sans with tabular numerals. No gradients, no blue student portal, no decorative crest. Calm substantial reading density and precise alignment. One accent used for active step and primary action only; green solely for verified readiness.
Full-width top product bar "Programación académica" with three short destinations "Programaciones", "Recursos", "Publicaciones"; compact right "Demo · datos sintéticos" and "Escuela · simulada". Beneath compact breadcrumb "Sistemas [v] / 2027-I [v] / Programación regular", plus "Borrador r9 · Guardado".
Layout is an APPROVAL DOSSIER with a light216px vertical process outline on left, large central change-review document about800px, narrow right readiness evidence rail280px. Left rail heading "Preparar publicación", sequential plain steps "1 Demanda" completed, "2 Horario" completed, "3 Revisión docente" completed, "4 Aprobación" active with wine left rule, "5 Publicación" next. At bottom left text "Vigente: publicación v1" not a pill.
Main document title "Revisar antes de aprobar",24px. One short sentence "3 secciones cambiaron respecto a la publicación v1." small link "Ver horario completo". Show version comparison controls as quiet inline text "Publicación v1 → Borrador r9" and a distinct check "12 secciones completas · 24/24 componentes".
Main dense CHANGES TABLE, not a metrics dashboard: header"Sección / Antes · v1 / Propuesta · r9 / Motivo". Three rows with readable multiline content:
Redes I · S02 | Jue14:00–18:00 · Lab SYN-L201 | Vie14:00–18:00 · Lab SYN-L201 | Disponibilidad docente
Bases de datos · S03 | Mar14:00–18:00 · Aula SYN-A101 | Mié14:00–18:00 · Aula SYN-A101 | Evitar cruce
Arquitectura de software · S02 | Aula SYN-A101 · Vie08:00–12:00 | Aula SYN-A102 · Vie08:00–12:00 | Capacidad del aula.
Use simple old/new typography and very light warm column tint, not colored badges. Beneath table modest heading "Revisión docente", simple4-row list Docente SYN-01,SYN-02,SYN-03,SYN-04 each "Conforme" with check and last reviewed date"7 nov2026"; concise "Todas las conformidades corresponden al horario actual." It is now a COMPLETE saved proposal, unlike earlier stages; review data is synthetic design scenario.
Right evidence rail heading "Lista para aprobación", three compact check lines "Sin cruces", "24 de24 componentes", "4 de4 docentes conformes"; fine separator; metadata "Periodo2027-I", "EscuelaSistemas", "Revisiónr9", "Publicación previstav2". Small explanatory paragraph "Aprobar congela esta revisión. Publicar será un paso posterior." This distinction must be clear. Thin status description "Aprobación simulada".
Sticky bottom action bar within document shows main wine button"Aprobar propuesta" aligned right; secondary text"Volver al horario" left; next stage"Después: Publicar v2" as noninteractive muted text. DO NOT show enabled Publish action before approval. No signature, no fake signed-in director identity, no automatic email/notifications, no AI layer.
This comparison view is a PROPOSED design requirement using versioned schedule snapshots; it is not already an implemented diff feature. The generated image should feel like a professional university operational approval tool, not a marketing page or generic SaaS dashboard. Clear persistent context, concise text, one primary decision, generous enough whitespace without wasting the viewport. No giant headings or round card piles. Target1440×900.
